item.title: GRID4EARTH
item.description:
GRID4EARTH is an European Space Agency Digital Twin Earth project building a unified, standardised data infrastructure based on Discrete Global Grid System (DGGS) for Copernicus Sentinel and Destination Earth data.

By leveraging DGGS and cloud-optimised formats like Zarr, data from different missions can be integrated more consistently and efficiently. This reduces the complexity of data processing and supports numerous use cases, from environmental and climate research to operational decision-making across Earth system service domains.

Project site →

Read more → — why DGGS indexing exists and how the same operation that wins a children’s-game lets a million Earth-observation cells fit into 8 MB of RAM.

item.title: WaterSmartLand
item.description:
WaterSmartLand is an ERC Consolidator Grant developing a framework to find spatially optimal land management for nature-based solutions (wetlands, riparian buffer strips) to reduce agricultural nutrient runoff. It uses a DGGS data cube, machine learning, and process-based hydrological modelling.

Project site →

Led by Prof. Evelyn Uuemaa at the University of Tartu (2024–2029).
